title: Make the dirty-folder task import refusal print a runnable recovery command
outcome: When loose selected edits prevent incremental import, keep the preservation advice and give a complete-import command the operator can run with the same worktree, branch and memory selection.
acceptance: In a non-default branch and memory-capable fixture, a dirty-folder refusal preserves the edits and prints a complete import retry with FOLDER, the applicable branch and memory opt-in, and the saved basis argument.
The printed retry runs after the operator has preserved the loose edits and restored the committed folder.
